title: Final test
summary: Ten questions on a new tree. No hints, no timer, and you can retake it with new numbers.
banner: No hints and no timer. Take your time.
firstNote: This is a new tree, U. You will see full explanations and replays after the last question.
retakeNote: This retake uses new numbers on the same tree shape.

outcomes.name: Name the parts of a tree
outcomes.lectureQuestion: Why is height counted in edges rather than nodes?

outcomes.name: Tell a valid BST from an invalid one
outcomes.lectureQuestion: Why is checking a node against its parent not enough to prove a tree is a BST?

outcomes.name: Trace a search
outcomes.lectureQuestion: What happens to search time if the keys are inserted in sorted order?

outcomes.name: Insert a key, and find the minimum and maximum
outcomes.lectureQuestion: Why do new keys always become leaves?

outcomes.name: Write the three traversal orders
outcomes.lectureQuestion: Where would each traversal order be useful in a real program?

outcomes.name: Delete a key in all three cases
outcomes.lectureQuestion: Why does delete use the in-order successor, instead of just moving one of the children up?

descriptors.name: Excellent
descriptors.meaning: You apply all six outcomes accurately, including the two-children delete.

descriptors.name: Good
descriptors.meaning: You apply most of the ideas accurately, with small slips.

descriptors.name: Satisfactory
descriptors.meaning: You handle the main operations correctly, with some gaps.

descriptors.name: Limited
descriptors.meaning: There are some gaps. The lecture will cover the missing ideas.

Valid: each parent has at most two children
